t: A free cloud-based professional CAD tool with class and assignment tools for schools.
steps: Go to the Onshape education page and sign up through the education form.
Ask IT to review the privacy terms before students join.
Have each student create an Onshape account.
Assign a document from the Intro to CAD learning path.
Try the CAD Drawings lesson with a small group first.
Check the usage analytics after the first week.
